size.$description: Component dimensions in px, shared by web and mobile. Never go below layout.touch-target-min for anything tappable.

control-sm.$description: Chips and filters (pad hit area to 44)

tab-bar.$description: Mobile bottom navigation height, excluding safe-area inset

state.$description: Interaction states. Pressed citrus uses color.brand.citrus-hover; pressed ink uses color.brand.ink-raised.

pressed-scale.$description: Press-in scale for buttons and cards

pressed-overlay.$description: Ink overlay opacity on pressed light surfaces
